probes.name: fixed_class
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As Long
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Helpers"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Public Sub Bump(ByRef number As Long)" & vbCrLf & "number = number + 10" & vbCrLf & "End Sub"
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Caller"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Function Probe() As Long" & vbCrLf & "Dim instance As New Thing" & vbCrLf & "Probe = instance.Check()" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(2)
part.Name = "Thing"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Private values(0 To 1) As Long" & vbCrLf & "Public Function Check() As Long" & vbCrLf & "values(1) = 5" & vbCrLf & "Helpers.Bump values(1)" & vbCrLf & "Check = values(1)" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
Probe = Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Caller.Probe")
target.Close False
End Function

probes.name: fixed_document
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As Long
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Helpers"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Public Sub Bump(ByRef number As Long)" & vbCrLf & "number = number + 10" & vbCrLf & "End Sub"
target.VBProject.VBComponents("Sheet1").CodeModule.AddFromString "Private values(0 To 1) As Long" & vbCrLf & "Public Function Check() As Long" & vbCrLf & "values(1) = 5" & vbCrLf & "Helpers.Bump values(1)" & vbCrLf & "Check = values(1)" & vbCrLf & "End Function" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub ExportValue()" & vbCrLf & "Range(""A1"").Value = Check()" & vbCrLf & "End Sub"
Application.Run "'" & target.Name & "'!Sheet1.ExportValue"
Probe = target.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value
target.Close False
End Function
